data.title: Cold start: from git clone to an owned conference — claim link, POST /events, invites, honest instance (M-65, AC-275–AC-287)

data.to:
Implement BUILDPLAN Amendment 12 / milestone M-65: the complete cold start, one vertical slice in walkthrough order. This ticket owns EVALUATION §2.4 (AC-275 – AC-287) via a claims manifest at tests/ac-claims/MRQ-105.json — landing that manifest is what turns the band's trace:ac enforcement on, so it ships in this PR together with the tests.

READ FIRST, in order: (1) BUILDPLAN.md Amendment 12 — the scope table and boundaries; (2) EVALUATION.md §2.4 — the thirteen ACs with their exact verification shapes; (3) SPEC.md Amendment 19 — schema deltas (magic_links purposes claim|org_invite with nullable person_id), route table, CLI verbs, §5 screen deltas; (4) sequence/USER_STORIES.md Amendment 19 (US-83 – US-86); (5) prototypes/cold-start/DECISIONS.md (rulings D1–D8) and prototypes/cold-start/SKILL-SETUP-CHAPTER.md (the agent-side contract to fold into cli/generate-skill.mjs renderSkill()); (6) docs/GETTING-STARTED.md (human-side contract; AC-287 removes its status banner and the README caveat IN THIS PR); (7) the cold-start flow in prototypes/pipeline-v1.1/index.html v1.11 — the binding markup for the unclaimed landing, claim, handoff, Instance panel, organizers card, and conference-scoped checklist.

SCOPE, in build order: migration widening magic_links; claim-link CLI verb + /claim/:token page + POST /api/v1/claim; unclaimed landing (renders ONLY when zero owner memberships exist — the seeded demo has one, so the deployed judged site must render byte-identically; hard guard, not a hope); post-claim scoped-token offer (ordinary api_tokens row, no new kind); POST /api/v1/events + /conferences/new UI + switcher ＋; org invites mint/exchange/revoke + organizer list/removal (sessions revoked in-transaction; last owner cannot self-remove); GET /api/v1/instance/status derived from real binding/secret presence + Instance panel + the AC-285 publish acknowledgment (warn-and-record, never hard-block); POST /api/v1/admin/remove-demo (is_demo scope only, idempotent); CLI setup verbs + SKILL setup chapter through renderSkill() (byte-equality test binding — reconcile verb names with what MRQ-104 already shipped before minting new ones); AC-287 docs-truth static scan.

BOUNDARIES: package.json untouched (no new dependencies). Suite budget 45 s objective — prefer tests/node for pure logic; each new Worker-backed integration file costs ~19 s, so consolidate into as few files as the ACs allow. Test titles are "AC-nnn · description" (trace:ac parses them). check:api registry/OpenAPI parity applies to every new route.

PROCESS: work in a fresh worktree off github/main (Marquee-worktrees/mrq-105), never the main checkout; commit early and often; PR via gh pr create --repo Stage-11-Agentics/marquee --base main. DO NOT MERGE — merging is human-gated, and this ticket is post-deadline scope that must not merge before the competition freeze clears (BUILDPLAN Amendment 12). When the PR is open and green, set this task to review and flag your surface.

data.body: Build resumed by agent:claude-opus-mrq-105 (prior surface closed during workspace reorg; nothing lost). Worktree clean at 1e511ed 'WIP — cold-start integration tests and claim/landing route edits'. Resuming from there: finish integration tests for AC-275–AC-287, complete half-finished route edits, run gates, open PR.

PR open and green: https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/marquee/pull/97

Gate: npm run pr-gate --ticket=MRQ-105 PASS (73s/120s budget) — three typechecks, production build, design contract, API contract, route map, hermetic suite, merged AC trace. trace:ac uncovered: 0 across 229 live criteria; claims manifest owns exactly AC-275–AC-287.

Rebased onto github/main (was 26 commits behind at 23a06b0). Pre-rebase diff was 276 files / -17355 — a wholesale revert of MRQ-106..MRQ-127. Post-rebase: 46 files, +3684/-46. Safety branch mrq-105-pre-rebase kept locally. Remote branch force-pushed with lease from the inherited WIP snapshot 1e511ed.

Three operator corrections landed: (1) the rebase; (2) demo_mode now inherits 1 iff org_id === SHIPPED_DEMO_ORGANIZATION_ID and is not a client field — it was hardcoded 0, and mail suppression rides that column, so a conference created inside the demo org would have sent live mail to a judge's address; (3) MRQ-125's caption kept — the conference name stays a div, the + sits beside it, both asserted in this ticket's own test. Judgement call taken: uniqueEventSlug scoped to org_id to match uq_events_org_slug.

Also added the unauthenticated 'setup health' CLI verb: the SKILL setup chapter had verified a fresh deploy with curl, which AC-143 forbids.

README §5 one-shot local smoke run green against this build (build 2da16c453046) — health, demo login, non-zero list; setup health answers; / still renders data-demo-role="organizer" with no unclaimed banner; instance/status returns real derived rows. Note: the README's fixed port 8787 collides with sibling agents' dev servers on this machine; the first run silently probed another agent's Worker (stale build stamp was the tell).

DO NOT MERGE — post-deadline scope, human-gated until the competition freeze clears.

Merged to main as f77a4f5 (squash, PR #97) on operator instruction 2026-08-12 12:25 EDT — the human merge gate, exercised ~12.5h before the competition freeze clears. Merging does not deploy (DEPLOY.md: no auto-deploy), but main is what any assembly or deploy is cut from during the freeze window; operator informed and proceeded.

Delivered: BUILDPLAN Amendment 12 / M-65, the complete cold start. AC-275-AC-287 all covered; claims manifest tests/ac-claims/MRQ-105.json owns exactly that band, which is what turns EVALUATION 2.4's trace:ac enforcement on. Migration 0011 widens magic_links (renamed from 0009 during rebase — main grew three 0009s and three 0010s, and this one rebuilds magic_links so it must apply last). One exchange implementation behind two doors; unclaimed landing behind a hard zero-owner guard; scoped-token handoff on the existing api_tokens route; POST /api/v1/events with /conferences/new and the sidebar +; organizer invites/removal; instance status derived from real bindings; warn-and-record intake acknowledgment; remove-demo; SKILL setup chapter through renderSkill(); docs-truth scan.

Three operator corrections landed before the PR opened: (1) rebased onto main — the branch was 26 commits behind and would have reverted MRQ-106..MRQ-127 wholesale (276 files/-17355 became 46 files/+3684/-46); (2) demo_mode inherits 1 iff org_id === SHIPPED_DEMO_ORGANIZATION_ID and is not a client field, closing a mail-safety hole where a conference created in the demo org would have sent live mail to a judge's address; (3) MRQ-125's caption kept — conference name stays a div, + beside it, both asserted here. Judgement call: uniqueEventSlug scoped to org_id to match uq_events_org_slug. Added the unauthenticated 'setup health' CLI verb because the setup chapter had used curl, which AC-143 forbids.

Evidence: pr-gate PASS 73s/120s (three typechecks, production build, design contract, API contract, route map, hermetic suite, merged AC trace); trace:ac uncovered 0 of 229 live criteria; CI fast-gate SUCCESS on the PR; README section 5 one-shot local smoke green against built artifact 2da16c453046, with / still rendering data-demo-role=organizer and no unclaimed banner — the judged-demo invariant, confirmed live.

Notes for whoever is next: the lattice auto-review timed out at 600s (infrastructure, not a finding) and was not re-run before merge. An unrelated rate-limit assertion in public-form.AC-25-42-155-157-231-234 flaked once at load 20.9 and passes at sane load — contention, untouched by this branch. The README's fixed port 8787 collides with sibling agents' dev servers on this machine; a first smoke run silently probed another agent's Worker and the stale build stamp was the only tell.
